heroHeadline: Mount Jack Fire Near Sooke Now 'Under Control' at 337 Hectares as Season Winds Down
heroSubtitle: BC Wildfire Service listed the Mount Jack wildfire west of Sooke as under control on September 29 after rain reduced fire behaviour to smouldering Rank 1. Remeasured at 337.23 hectares, it was the largest fire on Vancouver Island this season; about 60 personnel remain assigned and the Kapoor Regional Park and Galloping Goose Trail closures were lifted. No evacuation orders were issued, and no new deaths or national-level developments were identified this cycle.
